label: AI Insight UI — Analytics
info:
Analytics backend, REAL data only. All application traffic flows over
UIBUILDER §9 (link-from-ui-analytics → fn_analytics_fap_route → fn_analytics_trino_fap
→ link-response-analytics → link-from-response). The HTTP routes under
/api/v1/{meters,pv,weather}/:id/history are scheduled for removal after the §9
path is verified end-to-end.

FAP §9 actions:
  analytics.trends           — single-series timeline (metric/range)
  analytics.correlations     — Pearson r between two metrics
  analytics.anomalies        — gold.anomaly_candidates
  analytics.recommendations  — gold.ai_insight_outputs (real LLM outputs)
  analytics.meters.history   — fleet aggregate (gold.net_grid_hourly), :meter_id
                               preserved on response
  analytics.pv.history       — gold.pv_performance_hourly per :system_id
  analytics.weather.history  — gold.weather_hourly (fleet-aggregated)

If a Trino query returns no rows, response carries metadata.note='no rows in
window' and an empty array — never synthesised data (FAP §10 design rule 4 + §12).

name: analytics.* FAP — route + prepare SQL
execute Trino + shape FAP result
